snippet.title: Bravest! (Popular Japanese feature phone game title)
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4592120/Bravest/
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.moreread.bravest1
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/jp/app/id6761329352

“Bravest!” is a classic single-player RPG.
Featuring a battle system that combines a front-view perspective with “front and rear” formations, along with a four-person party system and a level-based progression, the game offers the classic fun and strategic depth of an RPG that anyone can enjoy with confidence.

This game was originally released on Japanese feature phones and became a huge hit, with hundreds of thousands of players. It garnered attention for its premise—“a NEET is summoned to another world and becomes a hero”—and was a pioneer in the isekai genre. In response to numerous requests, it has now been revived as a port optimized for modern platforms. It’s an RPG packed with humor from start to finish, yet one that truly inspires courage.

For this re-release, we used a proprietary i-mode compatible layer to faithfully recreate the original i-mode game. It features the nostalgic 12-dot retro font and retro audio, allowing you to play with the same atmosphere as the original. (Switchable)
While keeping the graphics and difficulty intact, we’ve adjusted the user interface and pacing, added controller support, and made other tweaks to ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience on modern devices.

◆Story◆
Yusuke Ogiwara, a NEET who’s all the rage these days.
One day, he woke up to find himself in a world he’d never seen before.
That world is currently in dire straits due to the Demon King.
There was an ancient legend in that world.
“When the Demon King appears, a hero from another world will save the realm.”
Summoned to this other world by a wizard, Yusuke
becomes a “sort-of” hero to defeat the Demon King,
and sets out on his journey.

Can Yusuke Ogiwara, the NEET summoned to another world, become a true hero and defeat the Demon King?
Please enjoy this adventure story that feels both nostalgic and thrilling.

◆Controls◆
[Move]: Arrow keys, D-pad, Left Stick
[Confirm]: Z key, Xbox A button, PS O button
[Cancel]: X key, Xbox B button, PS X button
[Quick Menu] : C key, Xbox Start button, PS L2 button
[Menu] : Tab key, Xbox Y button, PS △ button 
[Soft Key 1] : A key, L1 button 
[Soft Key 2] : S key, R1 button 

◆Formation◆
Select the character's position in battle from the front row or back row.
Placing a character in the back row makes them less likely to be targeted by enemy monsters.
It is more effective to place characters with low defense in the back row whenever possible.
Cast area-of-effect spells from a position where you are less likely to be targeted by enemies to end the battle quickly!

◆Changes from the Feature Phone Version◆
・Upgraded to 60fps
・Added convenience menu (full HP restore and shortcuts)
・Increased save slots from 3 to 9
・UI adjustments
・Enhanced certain effects
・Corrected some text

◆Notes◆
[※] This game runs at a fixed 60fps. If connected to a display with a refresh rate other than 60Hz (or a multiple thereof), the motion may feel choppy.
